svg.text: Encoding 4 data bits: computing the check bits

g.text: Data bits d0..d3 = 1 0 1 1 go to positions 3, 5, 6, 7. Positions 1, 2, 4 (powers of two) are reserved for check bits.
p1 covers every position whose binary number ends in 1: 1, 3, 5, 7.
p2 covers positions with the middle bit set: 2, 3, 6, 7.
p4 covers positions with the top bit set: 4, 5, 6, 7.
SECDED adds an overall parity bit over all 7 bits: 0⊕1⊕1⊕0⊕0⊕1⊕1 = 0. Stored word: 0 | 0110011

svg.text: Each check bit makes the parity of its group even. In hardware every check bit is one XOR gate.
